Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: sanctions
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Every member must embargo the named faction for 60 days, and its economy suffers. Members who keep trading are in violation.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: censure
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: A formal condemnation. Every member thinks less of the named faction, and its leader loses legitimacy.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ceasefire order
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Orders two warring factions to make peace within 7 days and keep it for 60. Refusing, or restarting the war, is a violation.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: collective defense
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: Names an aggressor. Every member must be at war with it within 10 days, or be in violation.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: common trade standard
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 120 days, members trade with each other on better terms (5% better prices) and their economies grow 2%.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: diplomatic immunity
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 180 days, attacking delegations or seizing envoys is a violation of council law.

Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.label: ban on slavery
Dominion.CouncilMotionDef.description: For 180 days, members may not keep slaves. Members found with slaves after 10 days are in violation.
